title: Perch and oz-policy-builder, side by side.
caption: Twelve of the twenty dimensions; every cell is read from source at Perch {{fact:perch-pin-short}}, oz-policy-builder {{fact:opb-pin-short}} and OpenZeppelin `stellar-contracts` {{fact:oz-v080-tag}}. The full comparison table in {{ref:sec:sources}} gives a source for each cell.
rows: Where the decision runs
Inside the account: the linked evaluator decides
In attached policy contracts, called by the account after authentication
Order of checks
Decide (caps included), then authenticate
Select rules (existence, scope, expiry) and refuse unlisted signers, authenticate, then run each policy in the rule's stored order
Where decision state lives
The account only
The account, the interpreter and `spending_limit`, each keyed by (account, rule)
Conditions on one call
Target, functions, {{fact:doc-conditions-count}} conjunctive argument conditions, threshold, expiry
A predicate language with and/or, comparisons, quantifiers, arithmetic, time and reads
Relating calls in one transaction
Each context alone
One predicate can relate the calls of an adapter batch
External state in the decision
None
Up to {{fact:opb-interpreter-max-reads}} cross-contract reads per `enforce`
Rolling spending cap
In the evaluator, window (L − P, L]; proved for the evaluator from empty records
Not in the interpreter; OpenZeppelin's optional `spending_limit` beside it, on `transfer` only, same window boundary
Threshold and signer kinds
Threshold in the rule; external (passkey, Ed25519) and delegated signers
Threshold through an attached policy; delegated signers only on policed rules
What a signature binds
External: account and rule IDs; delegated: account only
v0.8.0: account and rule IDs for both kinds
Ending authority in bulk
One counter makes every earlier grant refuse at recovery
Rules removed one at a time; a policed rule is pinned to its exact signer set
Assurance
Kernel-checked proofs about the evaluator's Lean translation, not its Wasm; shell tested, partly on Wasm; no audit completed
Tests, partly on the shipped Wasm; STRIDE register; external audit {{fact:opb-audit-status}}; OpenZeppelin's v0.8.0 diff audit lists its account storage and `spending_limit` in scope
Deployment
Testnet preview (earlier design on mainnet)
Interpreter on testnet; no mainnet pin
